questions.question: In 2019, what percentage of adults aged 18 to 64 covered by Medicaid had at least one emergency department visit in the previous 12 months?
Between men and women aged 18 and over, which sex had a higher age-adjusted percentage of adults with two or more emergency department visits in 2019?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_adult_ed_visits.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
two_or_more_col = None
for c in range(47, df.shape[1]):
    if df.iloc[4, c] == 2019 or str(df.iloc[4, c]).strip() == '2019':
        two_or_more_col = c
        break

male_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Male'].index[0]
female_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Female'].index[0]

male_val = float(df.iloc[male_row, two_or_more_col])
female_val = float(df.iloc[female_row, two_or_more_col])

result = 'Female' if female_val > male_val else 'Male'

questions.question: Which two geographic regions had the highest age-adjusted percentages of adults with one or more emergency department visits in 2019?
In which year between 1997 and 2019 was the crude rate of adults aged 18 and over with one or more emergency department visits at its lowest?
In 2019, was the percentage of adults with two or more emergency department visits higher for those living outside metropolitan statistical areas than for those living within them?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_adult_ed_visits.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
col_2019_two = None
for c in range(47, df.shape[1]):
    if df.iloc[4, c] == 2019 or str(df.iloc[4, c]).strip() == '2019':
        col_2019_two = c
        break

within_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Within MSA', na=False)].index[0]
outside_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Outside MSA', na=False)].index[0]

val_within = float(df.iloc[within_row, col_2019_two])
val_outside = float(df.iloc[outside_row, col_2019_two])

result = 'yes' if val_outside > val_within else 'no'

questions.question: In 2019, by how many percentage points did the proportion of seniors aged 75 and over with two or more emergency department visits exceed that of adults aged 65 to 74?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_adult_ed_visits.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
col_2019_two = None
for c in range(47, df.shape[1]):
    if df.iloc[4, c] == 2019 or str(df.iloc[4, c]).strip() == '2019':
        col_2019_two = c
        break

row_65_74 = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('65–74', na=False)].index[0]
row_75_over = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('75 years and over', na=False)].index[0]

val_65_74 = float(df.iloc[row_65_74, col_2019_two])
val_75_over = float(df.iloc[row_75_over, col_2019_two])

result = round(val_75_over - val_65_74, 2)
